answer: Clone keys often share one kiln invoice. An applicant stakes 84 locked units and completes a 22-minute wander across four tiles of a published saffron-kiln atlas, in the order H(pubkey||epoch) mod the roster. Each tile needs a 90-second dwell and a thermal stamp within 1.5 C of that tile's curve. Three peers replay the GPS-thermal log and reject any path whose invoice or refund address is already on another live wander. A missed dwell or off-curve stamp burns 24 units and cools the key seven epochs; a reused tile-order or second miss empties the lock and bars it fourteen epochs.
